name: Trader Joe's Mini Silver Dollar Pancakes (Frozen 36-Pack)
whyItWorks: Tiny, bite-sized fluffy pancakes made from refined flour, buttermilk, and sugar. They heat in 60 seconds and dissolve into tender, easily digested carbs. Low in fiber (under 1g).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave 6 mini pancakes for 45 seconds or toast lightly. Drizzle with pure maple syrup.
watchOuts: Refined white flour pancake; gentle comfort food for morning nausea.
